h15.text: The college has not implemented any new financial aid policies for the 2024–2025 aid year. However, the federal government introduced FAFSA Simplification, which replaced the Expected Family Contribution (EFC) with the Student Aid Index (SAI) and expanded aid eligibility for more students.
